description: A descriptive record of the anomaly detection and predictive alerting that run in production (ADR-087). No system reads this file. It replaces the Sprint-0 heuristic rules, which no running system loaded.
engineNotes: Grafana Asserts on the Grafana Cloud stack computes these rules from the span metrics the api and ai-worker export over OTLP. The rule set is managed by the Grafana plugin, not by this repository; the names below were read from production on 2026-10-22.

rules.name: RequestRateAnomaly
rules.detects: request rate outside its learned band

rules.name: ErrorRatioAnomaly
rules.detects: error ratio outside its learned band

rules.name: LatencyP95Anomaly
rules.detects: p95 latency outside its learned band

predictiveAlerting.sloBurnRate: Fast and slow burn-rate alerts on env008-api-availability warn before the 28-day error budget runs out (infra/monitoring/grafana/cloud/slos.json, applied by .github/workflows/grafana-slos.yml).
predictiveAlerting.notAlerting: env008-api-latency and env008-ai-worker-llm-success have no burn-rate alerts yet: their budgets are already spent in production (#1001, #1029).
predictiveAlerting.thresholdRules: The IFC-032 alert rules in infra/monitoring/grafana/cloud/alert-rules.json (applied by .github/workflows/grafana-alert-rules.yml).

notCovered: web, ws, events-worker and ingestion-worker emit no telemetry yet (EP-001-AI), so nothing above watches them.
